summary: Data centers and other sites reach backbone networks through gateway routers, often several. This document uses the BGP Tunnel Encapsulation attribute to let gateways advertise routes to prefixes in the site, including on behalf of other gateways, so Segment Routing can identify multiple paths between gateways for load-balancing, resilience and quality.

eli5.summary: A building with several front doors needs a way to tell visitors about all of them. This document lets doors announce themselves so the best path can be chosen.

questions: bgp tunnel encapsulation data center gateways
